amendments.normalized_body: In `crates/tank_data/src/presets.rs`, `temp_condition_min_factor` appears in two preset validation loops: the non-negative check (line ~913, `>= 0.0`) and the strictly-positive check (line ~1005, `> 0.0`). The strictly-positive list is designed for divisors and physical quantities where zero would cause division-by-zero; a clamp floor factor semantically can be zero. Remove `temp_condition_min_factor` from the strictly-positive list (line ~1005) to keep only the non-negative + finite check and the runtime `check_unit_interval` invariant. This eliminates an inconsistency where the preset validator rejects `temp_condition_min_factor = 0.0` but the runtime invariant validator (`check_unit_interval`) accepts it.
